rule: FROZEN. Authoring agents may not invent values outside these registries. A needed value that is absent must be returned as a contract_gap, never improvised.
note: All 107 rows are provenance=CLIENT-PDF. WBS requirements are absent from the client document and must be added with provenance=MASTER-PROMPT, never presented as a confirmed client requirement.

requirements.requirement_description: Establish project-wise Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) and Capital Work in Progress (CWIP) control within the Zoho ERP environment.
requirements.business_purpose: Give management a true view of available CAPEX budget before further procurement is approved.
requirements.actor: Atha Group management / finance (not named explicitly in PDF)
requirements.business_rule: Control must be project-wise (per capital project), covering both CAPEX and CWIP.
requirements.workflow: Umbrella statement over the 10-step workflow in section 3
requirements.accounting_impact: CWIP control implied; no GL detail stated at this point
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not name which Zoho products constitute 'Zoho ERP' at this point (section 10 later names Zoho ERP Purchase Request/PO/Purchase Receive/Finance and Zoho Analytics).

requirements.requirement_description: Core Control Principle: Available Budget = Current Approved Budget - Actual CWIP - Open PO Commitments.
requirements.business_purpose: Single governing formula for budget availability across the solution.
requirements.preconditions: Current Approved Budget, Actual CWIP and Open PO Commitment values exist
requirements.input_data: Current Approved Budget; Actual CWIP; Open PO Commitments
requirements.business_rule: Available Budget = Current Approved Budget - Actual CWIP - Open PO Commitments
requirements.workflow: Consumed by the Budget Availability Check (step 4) and PR/PO approval validation (section 7)
requirements.accounting_impact: Uses actual CWIP balances plus non-accounting commitment values
requirements.integration_dependency: Requires PO commitment data and CWIP actuals from Zoho ERP
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Available Budget is a dashboard column (section 12)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether the formula is evaluated at project level, budget-head level, or both — section 6 and section 7 apply it at budget-head level, section 12 at project level.

requirements.requirement_description: Approved budgets must be monitored not only against vendor bills (actual cost) but also against Purchase Orders (committed cost).
requirements.business_purpose: Provide management with a true view of available CAPEX budget before further procurement is approved.
requirements.trigger: Vendor bill booking and Purchase Order approval
requirements.preconditions: Approved budget exists for the project/budget head
requirements.input_data: Vendor bill amounts (actual cost); Purchase Order amounts (committed cost)
requirements.business_rule: Both actual cost and committed cost consume budget.
requirements.workflow: Feeds the availability formula in REQ-BUD-001
requirements.approval_requirement: Monitoring must occur before further procurement is approved
requirements.accounting_impact: Vendor bills are actual cost postings; POs are commitments only (no posting stated)
requirements.integration_dependency: Zoho ERP Purchase Order and Vendor Bill events
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Create a unique CAPEX / CWIP Project Code for every approved capital project.
requirements.business_purpose: Give every capital project a single identifier that follows all downstream transactions.
requirements.business_rule: Code must be unique per approved capital project.
requirements.workflow: Step 1 of the end-to-end workflow (CAPEX Project Creation)
requirements.approval_requirement: Project must be approved before a code is created (implied by 'every approved capital project')
requirements.accounting_impact: Project code is the dimension against which CWIP accumulates
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps this to project code / custom fields / dimensions (Configuration)
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Project is the primary dashboard grouping (section 12)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF gives one illustrative format 'CAPEX-2026-001' but does not state the numbering rule, sequence owner or whether it is auto-generated.

requirements.requirement_description: Maintain project-level and budget-head-level approved budgets.
requirements.business_purpose: Enable control at both the whole-project level and the individual cost-category level.
requirements.input_data: Approved budget amount per project and per budget head
requirements.business_rule: Budgets are held at two levels only: project and budget head.
requirements.workflow: Step 2 of the end-to-end workflow (Budget Approval)
requirements.accounting_impact: Budget values are control values, not postings
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps this to CAPEX Budget Master (Customization)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF defines exactly two levels (project, budget head). There is NO WBS / task / sub-activity level anywhere in the document.

requirements.requirement_description: Validate budget availability before Purchase Order approval.
requirements.business_purpose: Prevent commitments being raised beyond approved budget.
requirements.preconditions: PO carries a CAPEX Code and Budget Head
requirements.input_data: CAPEX Code; Budget Head; proposed PO value
requirements.business_rule: Availability check is a precondition of PO approval.
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps this to Budget Availability Validation (Customization)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Bullet says 'before Purchase Order approval'; section 7 says the check happens 'At PR/PO approval'. PDF does not state whether the check is enforced at PR, at PO, or at both.

requirements.requirement_description: Treat approved/open Purchase Orders as committed expenditure.
requirements.business_purpose: Reflect money already promised to vendors in the available-budget calculation.
requirements.business_rule: Approved/open POs consume budget as commitment.
requirements.approval_requirement: PO must be approved to become a commitment
requirements.accounting_impact: Commitment is not an accounting posting; it is a budget-control value
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps this to PO Commitment Register (Customization)
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Open Commitment is a dashboard column (section 12)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define the full set of PO statuses that count as 'open' beyond approved / part billed / fully billed / cancelled (section 8).

requirements.requirement_description: Convert commitments into actual CWIP as vendor bills are booked, without double counting.
requirements.business_purpose: Ensure budget exposure is not inflated by counting both a PO and its bill.
requirements.trigger: Vendor bill booking against a PO
requirements.preconditions: An open PO commitment exists for the bill
requirements.business_rule: Billing converts commitment to actual; the same value must not be counted twice.
requirements.workflow: Step 8 (Vendor Bill / CWIP); detailed in section 8
requirements.accounting_impact: Bill posts to CWIP GL as actual project expenditure
requirements.integration_dependency: Vendor bill event must update the commitment register
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Actual CWIP is a dashboard column (section 12)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state treatment of bills booked WITHOUT a PO (direct CWIP bills).

requirements.requirement_description: Provide controlled budget revision and exceptional approval for overruns.
requirements.business_purpose: Allow legitimate budget increases without silently breaking the original approval.
requirements.business_rule: Overruns must go through revision/exception approval, not normal approval.
requirements.accounting_impact: None stated; revision changes the control budget only
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps to Budget Revision Control and Exception / Overrun Approval (both Customization)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define the approval matrix / authority levels — section 14 phase 1 defers this to Discovery.

requirements.requirement_description: Maintain an audit trail from budget approval through procurement, accounting and final capitalization.
requirements.business_purpose: Auditability of the full CAPEX lifecycle.
requirements.input_data: Not stated in PDF at this point; section 13 specifies requestor, approver, date, reason and approval reference for revisions
requirements.business_rule: Trail must be unbroken across budget approval, procurement, accounting and capitalization.
requirements.approval_requirement: Approval events are part of the trail
requirements.accounting_impact: Accounting events are part of the trail
requirements.integration_dependency: Requires linkage across PR, PO, GRN, Bill and capitalization records
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Section 13 requires dashboard drill-down from project to PR, PO, receipt/GRN and vendor bill
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state retention period or whether a separate audit log entity is required.

requirements.requirement_description: Provide management dashboards for Budget vs Commitment vs Actual vs Available Budget.
requirements.business_purpose: Management visibility of budget consumption and exposure.
requirements.preconditions: Budget, commitment and actual data available
requirements.input_data: Approved budget; open commitment; actual CWIP; available budget
requirements.business_rule: Four measures must be shown together.
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps Management Dashboard to Zoho Analytics (Configuration / Custom)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state refresh frequency or dashboard access roles.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 1 — CAPEX Project Creation: create project/CWIP code, owner, location, department, asset category and timeline.
requirements.business_purpose: Establish the project master record that all later transactions attach to.
requirements.input_data: Project/CWIP code; owner; location; department; asset category; timeline
requirements.business_rule: All six listed attributes are captured at creation.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: 'Asset category' and 'timeline' appear here but are NOT in the section 5 field table; conversely section 5 adds Company/Unit, Original Budget, Current Approved Budget, CWIP GL and Status. The two lists are inconsistent.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 2 — Budget Approval: define original budget by budget head and capture approving authority.
requirements.business_purpose: Record the approved original budget and who approved it.
requirements.input_data: Original budget per budget head; approving authority
requirements.business_rule: Original budget is defined BY BUDGET HEAD (not as a single project lump sum).
requirements.approval_requirement: Approving authority must be captured on the budget
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether approving authority is a user lookup, free text, or an approval-matrix reference.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 3 — Purchase Request (PR): user raises PR against CAPEX Code + Budget Head.
requirements.business_purpose: Tie demand to the correct project and cost category at the point of origin.
requirements.trigger: Procurement need on a capital project
requirements.preconditions: CAPEX Code and Budget Head exist
requirements.input_data: CAPEX Code; Budget Head; requested items/value (items not detailed in PDF)
requirements.business_rule: PR must carry both CAPEX Code and Budget Head.
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps Purchase Request to Zoho ERP Purchase Request (Standard)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not list PR line-level fields, nor whether one PR may span multiple budget heads.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 4 — Budget Availability Check: system evaluates current budget, actual CWIP and open commitments.
requirements.business_purpose: Determine whether the request fits inside remaining budget.
requirements.preconditions: PR carries CAPEX Code and Budget Head
requirements.input_data: Current budget; actual CWIP; open commitments
requirements.business_rule: Evaluate all three components (per REQ-BUD-001).
requirements.workflow: Step 4 of 10, between PR and approval
requirements.approval_requirement: Result determines the approval route at step 5
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether the check is a hard block or an advisory value shown to the approver.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 5 — PR / Exception Approval: within-budget PR follows normal approval; excess requires exception/revision approval.
requirements.business_purpose: Route transactions to the right level of governance based on budget availability.
requirements.trigger: Completion of the budget availability check
requirements.business_rule: Two routes: normal approval (within budget) vs exception/revision approval (excess).
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 10 maps PR/PO Approval to Zoho ERP approval workflow (Standard / Configuration) and Exception/Overrun Approval to a conditional approval route (Customization)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define the normal approval hierarchy or the exception approval authority — deferred to Discovery (section 14 phase 1).

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 6 — Purchase Order: approved PO is created in Zoho ERP and reserves/commits the budget.
requirements.business_purpose: Convert an approved request into a budget commitment.
requirements.input_data: PO value; CAPEX Code; Budget Head
requirements.business_rule: PO creation reserves/commits budget.
requirements.accounting_impact: No GL posting stated at PO stage
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Feeds Open Commitment on the dashboard
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF uses 'reserves/commits' without distinguishing the two concepts.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 7 — Purchase Receive / GRN: receipt is recorded against the PO; commitment remains for the unbilled PO balance.
requirements.business_purpose: Record physical receipt without prematurely releasing commitment.
requirements.business_rule: GRN does NOT release commitment; commitment is released by billing (see section 8). Commitment remains for the unbilled PO balance.
requirements.accounting_impact: Not stated in PDF — the PDF does not say whether GRN creates a GL posting
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF is silent on whether GRN posts to a GRN-clearing / goods-received-not-billed account, and on whether receipt is quantity- or value-based.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 8 — Vendor Bill / CWIP: bill is posted to the relevant CWIP GL and becomes actual project expenditure.
requirements.business_purpose: Recognise actual capital expenditure against the project.
requirements.input_data: Bill value; CWIP GL; CAPEX Code; Budget Head
requirements.business_rule: Bill posts to the relevant CWIP GL and is treated as actual project expenditure.
requirements.workflow: Step 8 of 10 (heading appears on page 2, continues on page 3)
requirements.accounting_impact: Debit CWIP GL (specific ledger per section 5 'CWIP GL' field, e.g. CWIP - Plant & Machinery); credit side not stated in PDF
requirements.integration_dependency: Zoho ERP Finance (Standard) and dedicated CWIP ledgers (Configuration), section 10
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Feeds Actual CWIP on the dashboard
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state tax/GST treatment, freight/other charge treatment, or how the relevant CWIP GL is selected per budget head.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 9 — Project Completion: project is reviewed for closure; open commitments and pending bills are resolved.
requirements.business_purpose: Ensure nothing is left dangling before capitalization.
requirements.business_rule: Open commitments and pending bills must be resolved as part of closure review.
requirements.approval_requirement: Not stated in PDF ('reviewed for closure')
requirements.integration_dependency: Requires commitment register and bill status
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: 'Overdue CWIP projects' and 'projects awaiting capitalization' are recommended alerts (page 8)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define 'resolved' (cancel vs close-short vs write-back) nor who performs the review.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow Step 10 — Asset Capitalization: eligible CWIP is transferred to the appropriate fixed asset category and the project is closed.
requirements.business_purpose: Complete the transition from project expenditure to fixed asset.
requirements.preconditions: CWIP eligible for capitalization; open items resolved
requirements.input_data: Eligible CWIP value; target fixed asset category
requirements.business_rule: Only 'eligible' CWIP is transferred; project is closed after transfer.
requirements.accounting_impact: Transfer from CWIP GL to fixed asset category
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define eligibility criteria, partial capitalization, componentisation, depreciation start date, or whether a fixed-asset register module is in scope.

requirements.requirement_description: Workflow diagram: the process runs CAPEX/CWIP Project Creation -> Approved Budget & Budget Heads -> Purchase Request (PR) -> Budget Availability Check -> Approval / Exception Approval -> Purchase Order = Commitment -> Purchase Receive / GRN -> Vendor Bill = Actual CWIP -> Project Completion Review -> Fixed Asset Capitalization.
requirements.business_purpose: Visual restatement of the mandated linear sequence.
requirements.business_rule: Ten sequential nodes; the diagram asserts the equivalences 'Purchase Order = Commitment' and 'Vendor Bill = Actual CWIP'.
requirements.approval_requirement: Approval / Exception Approval is an explicit node
requirements.accounting_impact: Vendor Bill node is where actual CWIP arises
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The diagram is strictly linear with no loop-backs shown for rejection, PO amendment or re-validation, although section 9 and section 13 require both.

requirements.requirement_description: Each capital project must have a unique code that follows all related procurement and accounting transactions.
requirements.business_purpose: Single thread of traceability across procurement and accounting.
requirements.business_rule: The code must be propagated to all related procurement and accounting transactions.
requirements.accounting_impact: Code must be present on accounting transactions
requirements.integration_dependency: Project code / custom fields / dimensions (Configuration, section 10)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether the code is implemented as a Zoho project, a custom module record, a cost centre/dimension or a tag.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: CAPEX / CWIP Code (illustrative value CAPEX-2026-001).
requirements.business_purpose: Unique project identifier.
requirements.business_rule: Unique per project; mandatory on applicable capital procurement (section 13).
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Format 'CAPEX-YYYY-NNN' is illustrative only; the PDF does not mandate it.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Project Name (illustrative value 'New Production Line').
requirements.business_purpose: Human-readable project identification.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Company / Unit (illustrative value 'Atha Group Entity / Unit').
requirements.business_purpose: Identify the legal entity / business unit owning the project.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.integration_dependency: Section 14 phase 1 defers confirmation of entities/plants to Discovery
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Not listed as a dashboard drill-down dimension (section 11 lists Project / Plant / Department / Budget Head)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not list the Atha Group entities, nor whether Zoho ERP is one org per entity or multi-entity in one org.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Plant / Location (illustrative value 'Applicable Plant').
requirements.business_purpose: Locate the project physically for reporting and control.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.integration_dependency: Discovery phase to confirm plants (section 14 phase 1)
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Plant is an explicit Analytics drill-down dimension (section 11)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not list actual plants.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Department (illustrative value 'Manufacturing').
requirements.business_purpose: Departmental accountability and reporting.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Department is an explicit Analytics drill-down dimension (section 11)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not list departments.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Project Owner (illustrative value 'Designated Project Owner').
requirements.business_purpose: Single accountable owner per capital project.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.workflow: Step 1 ('owner' also listed in workflow step 1)
requirements.approval_requirement: PDF does not state that the Project Owner is an approver
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Not stated as a dashboard dimension
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether Project Owner has any approval or notification role.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Original Budget (illustrative value ₹1,50,00,000).
requirements.business_purpose: Preserve the first approved budget as an immutable baseline.
requirements.business_rule: Original budget remains unchanged when revisions occur (section 9); no silent overwrite (section 13).
requirements.approval_requirement: Set through the budget approval process
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Not a dashboard column in section 12 (which shows Current Budget)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Illustrative project total ₹1,50,00,000 matches the section 6 budget-head TOTAL, implying project budget = sum of budget heads, but the PDF never states this rule.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Current Approved Budget (illustrative value ₹1,50,00,000).
requirements.business_purpose: The live budget figure used in the availability calculation.
requirements.trigger: Budget approval and every approved revision
requirements.business_rule: Current Approved Budget = Original Budget + Approved Revisions (section 9).
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether Current Approved Budget is stored or computed, nor whether revisions are held per budget head.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: CWIP GL (illustrative value 'CWIP - Plant & Machinery').
requirements.business_purpose: Direct project expenditure to the correct CWIP ledger.
requirements.trigger: Project creation; used at vendor bill posting
requirements.business_rule: Vendor bill is posted to 'the relevant CWIP GL' (step 8).
requirements.integration_dependency: CWIP GL Accounting -> Dedicated CWIP ledgers (Configuration, section 10)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The field is single-valued at project level, yet budget heads span Civil / Plant & Machinery / Electrical / Installation / Consultancy — the PDF does not say whether the CWIP GL varies by budget head.

requirements.requirement_description: Project master field: Status.
requirements.business_purpose: Drive lifecycle control, including blocking procurement on closed projects.
requirements.business_rule: Closed/capitalized projects prevent further procurement unless reopened through approval (section 13).
requirements.approval_requirement: Reopening a closed/capitalized project requires approval (section 13)
requirements.accounting_impact: Capitalized status corresponds to CWIP-to-asset transfer
requirements.integration_dependency: Must be enforced on procurement documents
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: 'Overdue CWIP projects' and 'projects awaiting capitalization' alerts relate to status
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not define the transition rules between statuses, nor a 'Reopened' status despite requiring reopening by approval.

requirements.requirement_description: Project status values: Active / Completed / Capitalized / Closed.
requirements.source_section: 5. CAPEX Project & Budget Structure (field table, Status row)
requirements.business_purpose: Fixed vocabulary for project lifecycle state.
requirements.input_data: One of: Active, Completed, Capitalized, Closed
requirements.business_rule: Exactly these four values are listed in the PDF.
requirements.approval_requirement: Not stated in PDF per transition
requirements.accounting_impact: Not stated in PDF per status
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Difference between 'Completed', 'Capitalized' and 'Closed' is not defined; step 10 says capitalization also closes the project, which conflicts with having both values.

requirements.requirement_description: Project attribute: Asset Category (stated in workflow step 1 only).
requirements.business_purpose: Pre-identify the fixed asset category the CWIP will eventually be capitalized into.
requirements.business_rule: Step 10 requires transfer to 'the appropriate fixed asset category'.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Asset Category appears in workflow step 1 but is ABSENT from the section 5 field table; the PDF lists no asset category values.

requirements.requirement_description: Project attribute: Timeline (stated in workflow step 1 only).
requirements.business_purpose: Track expected project duration for overdue monitoring.
requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Implied basis for the 'overdue CWIP projects' alert (page 8)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: 'Timeline' is not broken into start/end dates and is ABSENT from the section 5 field table; the overdue-project alert has no stated threshold.

requirements.requirement_description: Maintain a Budget Head Control register holding, per budget head: Approved Budget, PO Commitment, Actual CWIP and Available.
requirements.business_purpose: Control capital spend at cost-category level within a project.
requirements.trigger: Budget approval and every PO/bill event
requirements.input_data: Budget head; approved budget; PO commitment; actual CWIP
requirements.business_rule: Four measures per budget head; Available is the residual.
requirements.approval_requirement: Approved Budget is set by approval
requirements.accounting_impact: Actual CWIP column derives from CWIP postings
requirements.integration_dependency: CAPEX Budget Master + PO Commitment Register (Customization, section 10)
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Budget-head is an Analytics drill-down dimension (section 11)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The illustrative table is shown for a single project; the PDF does not state whether budget heads are a global master list or defined per project.

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head 'Civil': Approved Budget ₹25,00,000; PO Commitment ₹5,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹12,00,000; Available ₹8,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrative budget-head control row.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head exists on the project
requirements.business_rule: 25,00,000 - 5,00,000 - 12,00,000 = 8,00,000 (consistent with the availability formula).
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: Figures are illustrative, not Atha Group's live data.

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head 'Plant & Machinery': Approved Budget ₹80,00,000; PO Commitment ₹30,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹35,00,000; Available ₹15,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrative budget-head control row; reused as the worked example in section 7.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head exists on the project
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head 'Electrical': Approved Budget ₹20,00,000; PO Commitment ₹6,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹8,00,000; Available ₹6,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrative budget-head control row.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head exists on the project
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head 'Installation': Approved Budget ₹15,00,000; PO Commitment ₹4,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹5,00,000; Available ₹6,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrative budget-head control row.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head exists on the project
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head 'Consultancy & Other': Approved Budget ₹10,00,000; PO Commitment ₹2,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹3,00,000; Available ₹5,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrative budget-head control row.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head exists on the project
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: '& Other' suggests a catch-all head; the PDF does not state whether the five heads are exhaustive.

requirements.requirement_description: Budget head TOTAL row: Approved Budget ₹1,50,00,000; PO Commitment ₹47,00,000; Actual CWIP ₹63,00,000; Available ₹40,00,000.
requirements.business_purpose: Roll up budget-head control to project level.
requirements.business_rule: TOTAL is the sum of the five budget heads and equals the project Original/Current Approved Budget of ₹1,50,00,000; 1,50,00,000 - 47,00,000 - 63,00,000 = 40,00,000.
requirements.report_or_alert_requirement: Project-level totals feed the management dashboard
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The PDF does not state whether the project budget must always equal the sum of budget heads, nor whether a project-level buffer/unallocated head is permitted.

requirements.requirement_description: Budget-head level availability: Available = Approved Budget - PO Commitment - Actual CWIP.
requirements.source_section: 6. Budget Head Control / 7. Purchase Order Budget Validation Logic
requirements.business_purpose: Apply the core control principle at cost-category granularity.
requirements.preconditions: Budget head has approved budget, commitment and actual values
requirements.input_data: Approved Budget; PO Commitment; Actual CWIP
requirements.business_rule: Same formula as REQ-BUD-001 applied per budget head; verified against all five illustrative rows and the TOTAL row.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The PDF does not state whether a transaction failing the budget-head check but passing the project-level check is allowed (or vice versa) — i.e. which level is binding.

requirements.requirement_description: At PR/PO approval the system must read the CAPEX Code and Budget Head and calculate the remaining budget.
requirements.business_purpose: Automate the availability decision at the point of approval.
requirements.preconditions: Transaction carries CAPEX Code and Budget Head
requirements.input_data: CAPEX Code; Budget Head; transaction value
requirements.business_rule: Remaining budget is calculated per CAPEX Code + Budget Head combination.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state behaviour for a multi-line PR/PO spanning several budget heads, nor for tax-inclusive vs tax-exclusive values.

requirements.requirement_description: Open PO commitments must be considered even where the corresponding vendor bill has not yet been received.
requirements.business_purpose: Prevent over-commitment during the gap between PO and billing.
requirements.business_rule: Unbilled PO value still consumes budget.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Worked example: ₹80L Budget - ₹35L Actual CWIP - ₹30L Open PO Commitment = ₹15L Available.
requirements.business_purpose: Illustrate the availability calculation at budget-head level (Plant & Machinery).
requirements.input_data: ₹80L budget; ₹35L actual CWIP; ₹30L open PO commitment
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: The example matches the Plant & Machinery row of section 6 but the PDF does not label it as such explicitly.

requirements.requirement_description: If a new PO of ₹20L is proposed against ₹15L available, the transaction exceeds available budget by ₹5L and the system must route it to an exceptional approval / budget revision process rather than treating it as a normal within-budget PO.
requirements.source_section: 7. Purchase Order Budget Validation Logic (example continuation)
requirements.business_purpose: Force overruns through governance instead of allowing silent breach.
requirements.trigger: Proposed transaction value exceeds available budget
requirements.business_rule: If proposed value > available, excess = proposed - available; route to exception/revision, not normal approval.
requirements.workflow: Step 5 branch into section 9 revision workflow
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether partial approval up to the available amount is permitted, nor any tolerance threshold before exception routing triggers.

requirements.requirement_description: The solution must avoid double counting a Purchase Order and its subsequent vendor bill.
requirements.business_purpose: Keep budget exposure accurate as a PO progresses to billing.
requirements.business_rule: Budget exposure must never exceed the PO value because of billing.
requirements.accounting_impact: Bill posts actual CWIP; commitment reduces correspondingly
requirements.integration_dependency: Bill event must reduce the commitment register
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Commitment-to-actual position 'PO approved': PO Value ₹20L; Actual Bill ₹0; Open Commitment ₹20L; Budget Exposure ₹20L.
requirements.business_purpose: Define budget exposure at PO approval.
requirements.business_rule: Open Commitment = PO Value - Actual Bill = ₹20L; Budget Exposure = ₹20L.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Commitment-to-actual position 'Part billed': PO Value ₹20L; Actual Bill ₹12L; Open Commitment ₹8L; Budget Exposure ₹20L.
requirements.business_purpose: Prove that partial billing does not increase total exposure.
requirements.trigger: Partial vendor bill posted against the PO
requirements.business_rule: Open Commitment = 20 - 12 = ₹8L; Budget Exposure = Actual Bill + Open Commitment = 12 + 8 = ₹20L (unchanged).
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Commitment-to-actual position 'Fully billed': PO Value ₹20L; Actual Bill ₹20L; Open Commitment ₹0; Budget Exposure ₹20L.
requirements.business_purpose: Commitment fully converts to actual with no double count.
requirements.business_rule: Open Commitment = 0; Budget Exposure = ₹20L (now entirely actual CWIP).
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not address over-billing (bill value exceeding PO value).

requirements.requirement_description: Commitment-to-actual position 'PO cancelled before billing': PO Value ₹20L; Actual Bill ₹0; Open Commitment ₹0; Budget Exposure ₹0.
requirements.business_purpose: Release budget when a PO is cancelled without billing.
requirements.business_rule: Cancellation zeroes both open commitment and budget exposure.
requirements.integration_dependency: PO cancellation event must release commitment (also section 13)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not cover cancellation AFTER partial billing, nor short-closure of a partially received PO.

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'Budget Exception Raised': a PO/PR exceeds the available project or budget-head limit.
requirements.business_purpose: Formal entry point into the overrun process.
requirements.business_rule: Exception is raised at EITHER project level OR budget-head level breach.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'Revision Request': user submits additional budget requirement with justification.
requirements.business_purpose: Capture the ask and the reasoning for audit.
requirements.business_rule: Justification is mandatory.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether the revision is requested per budget head, per project, or both.

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'Approval': appropriate authority approves/rejects additional CAPEX.
requirements.business_purpose: Governed decision on extra capital spend.
requirements.business_rule: Authority may approve or reject.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: 'Appropriate authority' is undefined; the CAPEX approval matrix is deferred to Discovery (section 14 phase 1).

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'Budget Version Update': original budget remains unchanged; the approved revision is separately recorded.
requirements.business_purpose: Preserve the baseline while recording increments — versioned budget control.
requirements.business_rule: Original budget is immutable; revisions are stored as separate records (no overwrite).
requirements.integration_dependency: Budget Revision Control -> 'Versioned revision + approval' (Customization, section 10)
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state whether negative revisions (budget reductions) are supported.

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'Current Budget': Original Budget + Approved Revisions = Current Approved Budget.
requirements.business_purpose: Define how the live control budget is derived.
requirements.preconditions: Original budget and approved revisions exist
requirements.business_rule: Current Approved Budget = Original Budget + Approved Revisions.
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: None stated

requirements.requirement_description: Revision stage 'PO Revalidation': the transaction is rechecked against the revised available budget.
requirements.business_purpose: Ensure the original blocked transaction only proceeds if it now fits.
requirements.business_rule: Recheck must be performed after revision; approval of a revision does not by itself release the transaction.
requirements.workflow: Stage 6 of 6, returning to step 5/6 of the main workflow
requirements.approval_requirement: Transaction proceeds only if it passes revalidation
requirements.ambiguity_or_open_question: PDF does not state what happens if the approved revision is still insufficient.

requirements.business_rule: Not stated in PDF — no ageing threshold given.

requirements.integration_dependency: Custom fields / dimensions on standard documents
